fusions.name: Mile-Weighted Cut
fusions.desc: A cut that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Column Advances
fusions.desc: A stepping advance of thrusts that deals 28 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles ahead of you. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Fencer's Footwork
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 25% for 8 seconds, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Drilled on Cobbles
fusions.desc: On paved ground, you deal 12% more damage.
